title: Canadian Apple Pie
description: This tasty Canadian double-crust apple pie is sweetened with - of course - maple syrup and seasoned with cinnamon and nutmeg.
ingredients: 1 pastry for a 9-inch double crust pie
2 tablespoons white sugar, or to taste
5 cups apple - peeled, cored, and sliced

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Line a 9-inch pie dish with 1 crust.
Whisk together cornstarch, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt in a large bowl until well mixed. Stir in apples, maple syrup, and whole egg until thoroughly combined.

Pour apple mixture into the prepared pie dish. Cover with remaining crust, seal edges, and cut away excess dough. Make several small slits in the top to allow steam to escape. Whisk together egg yolk and water in a small bowl until well combined; brush over the top of pie. Cover pie loosely with aluminum foil and place on a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven for 35 minutes. Remove the foil; continue baking until crust is golden brown, about 15 more minutes. Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
